RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: unknown—there is no defensible numerical estimate from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Neither does selecting another woman establish or rule out discrimination. Your longer experience matters, but digital expertise, interview performance and the published selection criteria could legitimately outweigh years served.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the criteria, their weighting, your assessment and the reasons the successful candidate was preferred. Focus on whether the process was consistent and fair, not panel members’ sex.

If evidence emerges of sex-related comments, inconsistent treatment or departures from recruitment rules, consider a formal complaint. Check applicable complaint deadlines; don’t assume awaiting a reply pauses them.
